notes: Synthetic case, no real patient data. WHAT THIS TESTS: the fallback when nothing is documented. Every act in this case is recorded as 'komplex' with a confidence of 1.0, but the record contains no besondere Schwierigkeit, no erhöhter Zeitaufwand and no erschwerende Umstände — that is, no written reason under § 12 Abs. 3 GOÄ. EXPECTED BEHAVIOUR: clinical complexity alone must not raise a factor, and the absence of a reason must not reject a line either. Every position falls back to its Schwellenwert (2.3 for Nr. 3, Nr. 7, Nr. 301 and Nr. 410; 1.15 for the § 5 Abs. 4 laboratory positions Nr. 3550 and Nr. 3741), no line is flagged justification_required, and each one instead appears in missing_documentation stating the factor the band would allow if the treating physician did document a reason. The engine says 'the record does not support more', never 'charge more'.
